verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a public API reference for Identity Verification, including the /identity_verification/retry endpoint. It also documents webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED), a Sandbox with fixed test inputs and custom test users, and machine-readable .md docs plus llms.txt. Together these let an AI-native user drive and test the product programmatically. Missing for 10: evidence of the full endpoint set (create/get/list sessions) beyond the retry endpoint, a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), API equivalents for Dashboard-only actions such as overriding results, and independent hands-on corroboration.
